newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Case says sees good six-month earnings.
newsitem.headline: Case says sees good six-month earnings.

text.p: U.S.-based agricultural and construction equipment maker Case Corp will present a good set of results for the first half of this year, the firm's European president said on Wednesday.
"Tomorrow we will release our six-month figures. It will be another good quarterly and half-year result. That applies to Case worldwide and in Europe," Leopold Plattner told reporters.
Case acquired 75 percent of ordinary shares in Austrian tractor manufacturer Steyr Landmaschinentechnik GmbH from Steyr Daimler Puch AG last year.
Plattner said the European agricultural machinery market had developed very positively while a construction slowdown had hurt building machinery sales.
"(But) overall our result in Europe is very good," he said. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
